decisions.reason: Adding a 330 kΩ pull-down to the MT3608 enable pin does not change the battery connector or its NTC connection.
The MT3608 enable pull-down does not alter the battery overcharge, overdischarge, or thermal-protection requirements.
The boost-converter enable pull-down does not change battery temperature sensing through the J_BAT NTC connection.
The source decision concerns the MT3608 enable bias and does not modify TVS-based ESD protection.
The 330 kΩ resistor is a pull-down on the MT3608 enable pin, not an I2C pull-up, so the I2C cable length, clock speed, and 4.4 kΩ pull-ups remain unchanged.
